home-intro.title: start
home-intro.tagline: blocks.system turns your own web content into individually addressable blocks.

manual-start.title: 01 / start the system
manual-start.intro: Load the two library files, create one system and attach it to an empty field.

manual-content-html.title: content / trusted html
manual-content-html.statement: Use a string for HTML you trust.
manual-content-html.body: The string becomes the content inside the block.

manual-content-node.title: content / dom node
manual-content-node.statement: Use a node for text or controls.
manual-content-node.body: Set textContent when text comes from a visitor, file or API.

manual-content-factory.title: content / factory
manual-content-factory.statement: Use a function for a fresh node.
manual-content-factory.body: The function runs when the block is added.

manual-finish.title: 02 / add the block
manual-finish.intro: Choose one content form above. Add it, give it a stable id, then size and place it on the grid.

manual-result-regular.title: result / regular
manual-result-regular.body: This is the regular built-in appearance.

manual-result-inverse.title: result / inverse
manual-result-inverse.body: Set variant to inverse when you add a block.

manual-layout.title: 03 / size and position
manual-layout.intro: A block occupies whole grid units. span() sets its size; place() sets its one-based position. flow() returns it to automatic order.

manual-layout-wide.title: result / 4 × 2
manual-layout-wide.statement: A wide block carries the main idea.
manual-layout-wide.body: Use more columns for code, media or longer reading.

manual-layout-small.title: result / 2 × 2
manual-layout-small.body: The same grid keeps both aligned.

manual-colors.title: 04 / add your colors
manual-colors.intro: The library has no named palette. You supply CSS colors in colorArray. colorVariation controls how often random blocks choose from that array.

manual-color-cyan.title: result / first color
manual-color-cyan.body: Color belongs to the block. Its content stays neutral.

manual-color-magenta.title: result / second color
manual-color-magenta.body: Replace these example colors with your own CSS values.

manual-color-yellow.title: result / third color
manual-color-yellow.body: The array is supplied by the user, never by the library.

manual-random.title: 05 / mix random variations
manual-random.intro: Random mode can mix your colors with regular and inverse blocks. First reserve a share for color; inversionVariation divides the remaining monochrome share.

manual-random-6.title: random / 06
manual-random-6.body: Each new random block resolves once.

manual-next.title: 06 / continue
manual-next.statement: Start small. Add only what your content needs.
manual-next.body: The examples cover a basic grid, mixed HTML and canvas content, and a custom runtime adapter.

reference-exports.title: 01 / exports
reference-exports.intro: Import a factory for an independent system, or use the shared system export.

cells: The same shared instance exposed in a browser.

reference-block.intro: add() returns one controller for one block.

reference-adapters.title: 07 / definitions and adapters
reference-adapters.intro: Definitions describe reusable content. Adapters own its mount and cleanup lifecycle.

cells: Return an Element or { node }, directly or through a Promise.

reference-event.title: 08 / reorder event
reference-event.intro: The field dispatches blocks:reorder after pointer or keyboard reordering.
reference-event.details: input is pointer or keyboard. mode is grid or flow. direction is up, right, down, left or still. Positions are { column, row } or null.

reference-errors.title: 10 / errors and boundaries
reference-errors.details: Expect errors for invalid or duplicate ids, missing fields, impossible grid positions, overlaps, unknown definitions, incomplete adapters and colorVariation without colors. Catch only errors your interface can recover from.
